title: Visual acuity screening at ages 4 and 5 years (Bright Futures/AAP periodicity schedule, footnote 7)

source.quote: A visual acuity screen is recommended at ages 4 and 5 years, as well as in cooperative 3-year-olds.

action: Perform a visual acuity screen for children aged 4 and 5 years.

derived.window: screen is due at the age-4 and age-5 visits; a child aged 4 or 5 at end of the measurement year reached that age during the year, so one acuity screen within the measurement year is expected
